numbered_fields.scope: Effective numbered recipes from exact smf-elements-0.txt through smf-elements-22.txt files, in loader order. No private files or runtime credentials are read.

There are 8430 ADVFN period-specific IDs (5620 quarterly,2810 annual). Numbered recipe counts do not equal unique economic metrics.
Coverage and legacy status are independent. Retired IDs remain part of the denominator but are not candidates for source repair.
Mapped field means a provider-qualified CFFIELD ID alias exists. No original RCHGetElementNumber wrapper or whole-SMF signature compatibility is provided.
All mapped fields retain CacheFinance units. This inventory does not assert identical raw numeric scaling to legacy recipes.
The fourteen other-provider candidates do not increase the count of mapped SMF IDs. No provider substitution is automatic.
The 51 SMF source-group labels are informational family names, not 51 distinct websites or providers. For example, AdvFN-A and AdvFN-Q share one provider, and Yahoo has many groups.
